prompt: Create one finished landscape 3:2 picture-book illustration. Clean flat 2D cartoon with crisp bold dark outlines, solid color shapes, restrained cel shadow, no grain, paint, photorealism, 3D, lettering, numbers, logos, panels or outer border. No people. The reference locks tree and plant designs ONLY, never copy its reference-board layout or add animals/props not explicitly requested. One simple integrated teaching view through several broadleaf branches to smaller shaded plants below. Clearly separated fine YELLOW LIGHT RAY ARROWS descend from upper left: two rays END at green leaf surfaces (absorbed), ONE ray strikes a leaf and a second arrow segment points back UPWARD into sky (reflected), ONE ray passes through a visible GAP between leaves continuing downward to a small plant. Arrowheads show exact movement, no arrows beginning under leaves then going upwards except the reflected one. Most incoming light intercepted, only one ray reaches the bottom. Natural plants not a solid roof. No numbers, words, legend, sun face, animals or duplicate panels. Keep teaching leaves, all arrowheads and small plant within central 70 percent.

visualReview.note: Teaching rays show two absorbed leaf paths, one leaf-reflected upward path, one transmitted gap path to young plant; no claim total light blocked.
